title: Executor components and wiring
caption: A Portal calls ExecutorRun, which pulls one row at a time up through the plan tree from the scan that reads table pages.

badges.meaning: ExecutorRun pulls from the top node, and each node pulls from its child
The SeqScan node reads table pages from disk
The row travels back up in a TupleTableSlot

title: One SELECT from start to finish
caption: Follow the numbers: the executor builds its state tree first, then pulls rows, sends them to the client and cleans up.

badges.meaning: PortalStart picks a strategy and starts the executor
ExecutorStart creates the EState and calls InitPlan
ExecInitNode builds one PlanState per Plan node
WHERE and target lists are compiled into expression steps
PortalRun calls ExecutorRun, which loops in ExecutePlan
Each node pulls a row from its child with ExecProcNode
The DestReceiver sends each row to the client

title: Anatomy of a TupleTableSlot
caption: A slot carries one row between nodes: tts_ops says what kind it is, and the value and null arrays hold the columns, or it can just point into a buffer page.

badges.meaning: tts_ops selects one of the four slot kinds
tts_values and tts_isnull hold the current row's columns and NULL flags
A buffer slot pins a page and points at the tuple inside, with no copy
